experiment: Misskey Hub standalone Markdown renderer, complete package build, A/B/B/A
method: One fully built local candidate package is used in every sample, with the standalone entry unused in the control.
Fresh Node process per sample; original files read and all 1991 routes regenerated. No persisted content, renderer, or output cache.

Both variants use identical diagnostic snippet preparation, router/sidebar caches, parallel data preparation, 8 render workers, renderer pre-bundling, asynchronous output preparation, and generated HTML tree API.

Candidate imports createOxContentMarkdownRenderer from the compiled /markdown entry instead of creating a Vite server to obtain a host Markdown context. Source load hooks transpile the archived consumer TypeScript helpers.
Timer includes client compilation, data/renderer worker startup and cleanup, public file copying and old output cleanup, page rendering and output writes.
Verification and SHA256 comparisons run outside the timed build. These diagnostics are not a published Misskey reference implementation.
limits: Four samples on one machine; startup timing varies.
Whole-build timings include other diagnostic consumer improvements and are not the published default consumer behavior.
The existing whole-site published 3.6.0 default build remains about 28 seconds.
